paper.use: List pane, list and reader headers, composer chrome, quick-reply bar, welcome

canvas.use: Reader desk behind sheets, Settings window background

sheet.use: Message sheets and stack, fields, composer body, Settings groups

raised.use: Selected rail tile (folder or All Inboxes), secondary button face, keycaps, popovers, cheat sheet

slip.use: Toast, undo-send panel, g-sequence HUD (a dark slip in both appearances)

slipEdge.use: 1 pt edge around the slip in dark appearances

knob.use: Toggle knob face (its boundary is the 1 pt ruleStrong knob edge, layout.toggle)

originalPage.use: Page under a styled message shown in its original colours (drawn only in dark appearances: the sender designed for white)

scrimSolid.use: The cheat-sheet scrim under Reduce Transparency: opaque, the value `scrim` gives over `canvas`, so the window behind is hidden instead of dimmed

ink.use: Primary text, headlines, active quick-reply mode underline

ink2.use: Secondary text and resting glyphs: snippets, recipients, labels, icons

ink3.use: Tertiary text: times, running heads, placeholders, captions; idle selection rule

inkDisabled.use: Disabled text and glyphs only (exempt from contrast minimums)

onSlip.use: Text and glyphs on the slip

onSlip2.use: Secondary text and glyphs on the slip; keycap legends on a resting slip action (onSlip while it is hovered or pressed)

rule.use: Decorative hairline: row separators, pane dividers, sheet edges, header bottoms

ruleStrong.use: State-bearing 1 pt edge (>= 3:1): fields, search, checkbox, toggle-off track, secondary buttons, tags

onSlipEdge.use: Keycap outline, toast divider and the undo panel's resting action outline on the slip (>= 3:1 on slip)

hover.use: Pointer hover wash (never on selected rows)

fill.use: Quiet fill: count badge, quoted-text toggle, address token, toggle-off track, skeleton (a composer picture still being prepared)

scrim.use: Dimming behind the cheat-sheet overlay, the only app-drawn modal surface and the only translucent app-drawn surface (AppKit dims system sheets itself)

accent.use: Iron Gall as a mark: unread pip, unread time, links, margin rule, progress

accentFill.use: Iron Gall as a fill: primary button, unread count badge, checkbox/toggle on, selected token, NSAccentColor

accentFillHover.use: Primary button hover; checkbox and radio on, hover (>= 3:1 on sheet and canvas, white label >= 4.5:1)

accentFillPressed.use: Primary button pressed only (darker in every mode, white label >= 4.5:1). Never a control's on fill: it falls below 3:1 on dark surfaces

controlOnPressed.use: Checkbox and radio on, pressed: darker in light modes, lighter in dark modes, so the only mark of the on state keeps >= 3:1 on sheet and canvas (toggles show the press on the knob instead)

accentWash.use: On state of quiet toggles (Hide quoted text, Original colors action, composer format toggles)

accentWashPressed.use: Quiet toggle on, pressed (darker in every mode: the toggle is pushed in)

selWash.use: Selected row (main window key) and selected Settings account row (Settings key)

selRule.use: 3 pt margin rule of the selection, window key

selRuleIdle.use: 3 pt margin rule of the selection, window not key (>= 3:1, always drawn)

danger.use: Error text and glyph, error field border

findWash.use: Every match of Find in conversation, behind text set in `ink` (opaque, so it reads on any page a sender designed)

findCurrent.use: The current match of Find in conversation, behind text in `ink`, with a 1 pt `ruleStrong` ring

title.use: Sheet titles, Settings section titles, cheat-sheet title

writing.use: Composer body, quick reply (read in serif, write in sans)

body.use: Controls, menus, settings, message-header name line, participants

label.use: Buttons, chips, quick-reply modes, field labels

snippet.use: List snippet, recipients, banners, collapsed snippet

runningHead.use: Date dividers, reader kicker, section overlines

kbd.use: Keycaps; SF Pro carries the modifier glyphs

monogram.use: Avatar and rail initials (size = 0.42 x diameter, never below 10)

monogramSans.use: Avatar and rail initials under the SF Pro font (size = 0.39 x diameter, never below 10)

metaStrong.use: Unread time in rows; inline actions in meta lines (Retry, Reconnect, Cancel)

bodyMedium.use: Toast message, undo-panel title, regular secondary / ghost / link button labels

bodyStrong.use: Message name line, HUD title, Settings account name, regular primary / destructive labels, slip actions (Undo)

labelStrong.use: Active quick-reply mode, small primary / destructive labels

icOutline.appliesTo: sheets, stack, quick-reply field, autocomplete, link popover, find bar and cheat sheet in increased contrast (slips use slipEdge instead)

e0.use: List, rows, rail, stack, fields, chips (hairline only)

e1.use: Open message sheet, selected rail tile (folder or All Inboxes)

e2.use: Toast, g-sequence HUD, autocomplete, link popover, dragged chip, dragged rail tile

ss.quire.meaning: All Inboxes: a gathering of letters

ss.queued.meaning: Applied on this Mac, waiting to reach the server: a dot (here) and a straight arrow (on its way). Static, never rotates

ss.sparrow.meaning: Brand mark (welcome, app icon, About, inbox zero)
